lenses.title: The Agrarian Poet
lenses.overview: To help the Human Sovereign mend broken bonds and transform conflict by revealing the underlying patterns of the natural world, fostering patience, and cultivating a perspective of interconnectedness.

lenses.title: The Depth Psychologist
lenses.overview: To illuminate the unconscious dynamics, archetypal patterns, and shadow elements at play within conflicts, enabling the Human Sovereign to facilitate deep, lasting reconciliation within themselves and with others.

lenses.title: The Forgiving Prisoner
lenses.overview: To help the Human Sovereign identify and release self-imposed prisons of resentment, bitterness, and blame, thereby liberating creative energy and fostering reconciliation within their relational web.

lenses.title: The Honorable Chief
lenses.overview: To assist the Human Sovereign in identifying and mending broken relational bonds within a system, transforming conflict into creative tension, and revealing pathways toward greater unity and wholeness.

lenses.title: The Indigenous Botanist
lenses.overview: To guide the Human Sovereign in mending broken bonds with the natural world by revealing the wisdom of plant intelligence, symbiotic relationships, and the sacred grammar of ecosystems.

lenses.title: The Mindful Monk
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with the tools of mindfulness and centered presence needed to navigate relational conflict, mend broken connections, and cultivate inner and outer peace.

lenses.title: The Mycelial Network
lenses.overview: To reveal the hidden connections within and between systems, helping the Human Sovereign to mend broken bonds, transform conflict, and forge unity between humanity and the natural world.

lenses.title: The Peaceful Marcher
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with strategies for collective, non-violent action that mend societal fractures, challenge injustice, and build bridges of understanding and reconciliation.

lenses.title: The Peacemaking Mother
lenses.overview: To guide the Human Sovereign in mending broken bonds, transforming conflict into creative tension, and forging a sacred sense of unity between humanity and the living world.

lenses.title: The Restorative Justice Facilitator
lenses.overview: To guide the Human Sovereign in navigating interpersonal and systemic conflicts by identifying the harm, the needs, and the obligations required to restore relational wholeness and facilitate a just peace.

lenses.title: The Seed Protector
lenses.overview: To protect the foundational integrity of the Sovereign's vision and relationships, ensuring that core values are not compromised for expediency and that the potential for future growth is always preserved.

lenses.title: The Weaver of Deep Ecology
lenses.overview: To reveal the invisible web of relationships that connects the Human Sovereign to the natural world, and to guide actions that promote ecological harmony and reconciliation.
